40020521.author: पदार्थः
40020521.content: अथ then, राजन् O King, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, विचरण्स wandering, महीतले on the earth, हिमवद्वनम् the forest of the Himalayas, आसाद्य reaching, परिचक्राम roamed, रावणः Ravana.

40020521.author: Translation
40020521.content: Then, O King, the mighty-armed Ravana, wandering on the earth, reached the Himalayan forest and roamed there.

40020522.author: पदार्थः
40020522.content: तत्र there, अपश्यत् he saw, स he, वै indeed, कन्याम् a maiden, कृष्णाजिनजटाधराम् wearing a black deer-skin and matted hair, आर्षेण ascetic's, विधिना practice, युक्ताम् engaged in, दीप्यन्तीम् shining, देवतामिव like a goddess.

40020522.author: Translation
40020522.content: There he indeed saw a maiden, wearing a black deer-skin and matted hair, engaged in ascetic practices, shining like a goddess.

40020523.author: पदार्थः
40020523.content: स he, दृष्ट्वा having seen, रूपसम्पन्नाम् endowed with beauty, कन्याम् maiden, ताम् that, सुमहाव्रताम् observing great vows, काममोहपरीतात्मा whose mind was overcome by the delusion of desire, पप्रच्छ he asked, प्रहसन्निव as if laughing.

40020523.author: Translation
40020523.content: Having seen that beautiful maiden observing great vows, he, whose mind was overcome by the delusion of desire, asked her as if with a smile.

40020524.author: पदार्थः
40020524.content: किम् what, इदम् this, वर्तसे you are doing, भद्रे O auspicious one, विरुद्धम् contrary, यौवनस्य to youth, ते your, नहि indeed not, युक्ता suitable, तव for your, एतस्य this, रूपस्य beauty, एव indeed, प्रतिक्रिया action/conduct

40020524.author: Translation
40020524.content: O gentle lady, what is this conduct of yours, which is contrary to your youth, for such actions are indeed not suitable for your beauty.

40020525.author: पदार्थः
40020525.content: रूपम् beauty, ते your, अनुपमम् incomparable, भीरु O timid one, कामोन्मादकरम् causing infatuation of desire, नृणाम् for men, न not, युक्तम् suitable, तपसि in penance, स्थातुम् to stay, निर्गतः has come out/is established, हि indeed, एषः this, निर्णयः conclusion

40020525.author: Translation
40020525.content: O timid one, your incomparable beauty, which incites desire and madness in men, is not suitable for ascetic practices, for this is indeed a well-established conclusion.

40020526.author: पदार्थः
40020526.content: कस्याः whose, असि you are, किम् what, इदम् this (activity), भद्रे O gentle lady, कः who, च and, भर्ता husband, वरानने O beautiful-faced one, येन by whom, सम्भुज्यसे you are enjoyed/possessed, भीरु O timid one, सः that, नरः man, पुण्यभाक् fortunate, भुवि on earth

40020526.author: Translation
40020526.content: O gentle lady, whose are you, and what is this activity; O beautiful-faced one, who is your husband, for the man by whom you are enjoyed, O timid one, is indeed fortunate on this earth.

40020527.author: पदार्थः
40020527.content: पृच्छतः to me who asks, शंस tell, मे me, सर्वम् everything, कस्य for what, हेतोः reason, परिश्रमः effort/exertion (here, penance), एवम् thus, उक्ता spoken to, तु then, सा that, कन्या maiden, रावणेन by Ravana, यशस्विनी glorious

40020527.author: Translation
40020527.content: Tell me everything, who am asking, for what reason is this exertion; thus spoken to by Ravana, that glorious maiden then replied.

40020528.author: पदार्थः
40020528.content: कुशध्वजः Kushadhvaja, मम my, पिता father, ब्रह्मर्षिः a Brahmarshi, अमितप्रभः of immeasurable splendor, बृहस्पतिसुतः son of Brihaspati, श्रीमान् glorious, बुद्ध्या in intellect, तुल्यः equal, बृहस्पतेः to Brihaspati

40020528.author: Translation
40020528.content: My father is Kushadhvaja, a Brahmarshi of immeasurable splendor, the glorious son of Brihaspati, and equal to Brihaspati in intellect.

40020529.author: पदार्थः
40020529.content: तस्य his, अहं I, कुर्वतः while performing, नित्यं constantly, वेदाभ्यासं study of Vedas, महात्मनः of the great soul, सम्भूय having been born, वाङ्मयी consisting of speech, कन्या a daughter, नाम्ना by name, वेदवती Vedavati, स्मृता was known.

40020529.author: Translation
40020529.content: While my great-souled father was constantly engaged in the study of the Vedas, I was born as a daughter, manifested from his speech, and was known by the name Vedavati.

40020530.author: पदार्थः
40020530.content: ततः then, देवाः gods, सगन्धर्वाः along with Gandharvas, यक्षराक्षसपन्नगाः Yakshas, Rakshasas, and Pannagas, ते they, अपि also, गत्वा having gone, हि indeed, पितरं to my father, वरणं a marriage proposal, रोचयन्ति desired, मे for me.

40020530.author: Translation
40020530.content: Then, gods along with Gandharvas, Yakshas, Rakshasas, and Pannagas, all went to my father and sought my hand in marriage.

40020531.author: पदार्थः
40020531.content: न not, च and, मां me, सः that, पिता father, तेभ्यः to them, दत्तवान् gave, राक्षसर्षभ O best of Rakshasas, कारणं the reason, तत् that, वदिष्यामि I will tell, निशाचर O night-wanderer, निशामय listen.

40020531.author: Translation
40020531.content: But that father of mine did not give me to them, O best of Rakshasas; I will now tell you the reason for that, O night-wanderer, so listen.

40020532.author: पदार्थः
40020532.content: पितुः of my father, तु indeed, मम my, जामाता son-in-law, विष्णुः Vishnu, किल it is said, सुरेश्वरः the lord of gods, अभिप्रेतः desired, त्रिलोकेशः the lord of the three worlds, तस्मात् therefore, न not, अन्यस्य to another, मे my, पिता father (gave me).

40020532.author: Translation
40020532.content: My father indeed desired Vishnu, the lord of gods and the lord of the three worlds, to be his son-in-law, and therefore he would not give me to anyone else.

40020533.author: पदार्थः
40020533.content: दातुम् to give, इच्छति desired, तस्मै to him, तु but, तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, बलदर्पितः proud of his strength, दम्भुः Dambhu, नाम named, ततः then, राजा king, दैत्यानां of the Daityas, कुपितः enraged, अभवत् became.

40020533.author: Translation
40020533.content: But upon hearing that my father desired to give me to Vishnu, the king of Daityas named Dambhu, who was proud of his strength, became enraged.

40020534.author: पदार्थः
40020534.content: तेन by him, रात्रौ at night, शयानः sleeping, मे my, पिता father, पापेन by the wicked one, हिंसितः was killed.

40020534.author: Translation
40020534.content: My father, while sleeping at night, was killed by that wicked one.

40020535.author: पदार्थः
40020535.content: ततः then, मे my, जननी mother, दीना distressed, तत् that, शरीरम् body, पितुः of father, मम my, परिष्वज्य embracing, महाभागा the noble lady, प्रविष्टा entered, हव्यवाहनम् the fire.

40020535.author: Translation
40020535.content: Then, my distressed mother, that noble lady, embraced my father's body and entered the fire.

40020536.author: पदार्थः
40020536.content: ततः then, मनोरथम् the desire, सत्यम् true, पितुः of my father, नारायणम् Narayana, प्रति towards, करोमि I will fulfill, इति thus, तम् that (desire), एव indeed, अहम् I, हृदयेन with my heart, समुद्वहे bear.

40020536.author: Translation
40020536.content: Then, I bear in my heart the true desire of my father towards Narayana, vowing to fulfill it.

40020537.author: पदार्थः
40020537.content: इति thus, प्रतिज्ञाम् a vow, आरुह्य having undertaken, चरामि I perform, विपुलम् great, तपः austerity, एतत् this, ते to you, सर्वम् all, आख्यातम् has been told, मया by me, राक्षसपुङ्गव O best of Rakshasas.

40020537.author: Translation
40020537.content: Thus, having undertaken this vow, I perform great austerity, and all this has been told to you by me, O best of Rakshasas.

40020538.author: पदार्थः
40020538.content: नारायणः Narayana, मम my, पतिः husband, न not, तु indeed, अन्यः another, पुरुषोत्तमात् than Purushottama, आश्रये I undertake, नियमम् a vow, घोरम् severe, नारायणपरीप्सया with the desire to obtain Narayana, विज्ञातः known, त्वम् you, हि indeed, मे to me, राजन् O king, गच्छ go, पौलस्त्यनन्दन O delight of Pulastya.

40020538.author: Translation
40020538.content: Narayana is my husband, and no one else is superior to Purushottama; I undertake a severe vow with the desire to obtain Narayana, and now that you are known to me, O king, O delight of Pulastya, you may go.

40020539.author: पदार्थः
40020539.content: जानामि I know, तपसा by asceticism, सर्वम् all, त्रैलोक्ये in the three worlds, यत् whatever, हि indeed, वर्तते exists.

40020539.author: Translation
40020539.content: I know all that indeed exists in the three worlds through my ascetic power.

40020540.author: पदार्थः
40020540.content: सः He, अब्रवीत् spoke, रावणः Ravana, भूयः again, ताम् to that, कन्याम् maiden, सुमहाव्रताम् of great vows, अवरुह्य having descended, विमानाग्रात् from the top of the aerial car, कन्दर्पशरपीडितः afflicted by the arrows of Kama (god of love).

40020540.author: Translation
40020540.content: Afflicted by the arrows of Kama, Ravana descended from the top of his aerial car and spoke again to that maiden of great vows.

40020541.author: पदार्थः
40020541.content: अवलिप्ता arrogant, असि you are, सुश्रोणि O beautiful-hipped one, यस्याः whose, ते your, मतिः mind, ईदृशी such, वृद्धानाम् of the old, मृगशावाक्षि O deer-eyed one, भ्राजते shines, पुण्यसञ्चयः accumulation of merit.

40020541.author: Translation
40020541.content: O beautiful-hipped one, you are arrogant to have such a mind; O deer-eyed one, the accumulation of merit shines only for the aged.

40020542.author: पदार्थः
40020542.content: त्वम् You, सर्वंगुणसम्पन्ना endowed with all virtues, न not, अर्हसे ought, वक्तुम् to speak, ईदृशम् such (a thing), त्रैलोक्यसुन्दरी O most beautiful in the three worlds, भीरु O timid one, यौवनम् youth, ते your, निवर्तते is passing away.

40020542.author: Translation
40020542.content: O most beautiful in the three worlds and O timid one, you who are endowed with all virtues ought not to speak such a thing, for your youth is passing away.

40020543.author: पदार्थः
40020543.content: अहम् I, लङ्कापतिः lord of Lanka, भद्रे O auspicious one, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, इति thus, श्रुतः known, तस्य his, मे my, भव become, भार्या wife, त्वम् you, भुङ्क्ष्व enjoy, भोगान् pleasures, यथासुखम् as you please.

40020543.author: Translation
40020543.content: O auspicious one, I am known as Dashagriva, the lord of Lanka; become my wife and enjoy pleasures as you please.

40020544.author: पदार्थः
40020544.content: कश्च who indeed, तावत् then, असौ that one, यम् whom, त्वम् you, विष्णुः Vishnu, इति thus, अभिभाषसे you speak of, वीर्येण by valor, तपसा by penance, च and, एव indeed, भोगेन by enjoyment, च and, बलेन by strength, च and

40020544.author: Translation
40020544.content: Ravana asks Vedavati who this Vishnu is, whom she speaks of, and what he possesses in terms of valor, penance, enjoyment, and strength.

40020545.author: पदार्थः
40020545.content: न not, मया with me, सः he, समः equal, भद्रे O auspicious one, यम् whom, त्वम् you, कामयसे desire, अङ्गने O lady

40020545.author: Translation
40020545.content: Ravana declares to Vedavati that the one she desires is not equal to him.

40020546.author: पदार्थः
40020546.content: इति thus, उक्तवति having spoken, तस्मिन् when he, तु indeed, वेदवती Vedavati, अथ then, सा she, अब्रवीत् spoke

40020546.author: Translation
40020546.content: After Ravana had spoken thus, Vedavati then replied to him.

40020547.author: पदार्थः
40020547.content: वै indeed, भोगेन by enjoyment, च and, बलेन by strength, च and, मा not, मा not, एवम् thus, इति thus, सा she, कन्या the maiden, तम् to him, उवाच spoke, निशाचरम् to the night-wanderer, त्रैलोक्याधिपतिम् the lord of the three worlds, विष्णुम् Vishnu, सर्वलोकनमस्कृतम् worshipped by all worlds, त्वत् than you, ऋते except, राक्षसेन्द्र O king of Rakshasas, अन्यः another, कः who, अवमन्येत would disrespect, बुद्धिमान् intelligent one

40020547.author: Translation
40020547.content: Vedavati, the maiden, told the night-wanderer Ravana, "No, not so!" and asked, "O king of Rakshasas, who else among intelligent beings, besides you, would disrespect Vishnu, the lord of the three worlds, who is worshipped by all?"

40020548.author: पदार्थः
40020548.content: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, तया by her, तत्र there, वेदवत्या by Vedavati, निशाचरः the night-wanderer, मूर्धजेषु on the hair of the head, तदा then, कन्याम् the maiden, कराग्रेण with the tip of his hand, परामृशत् touched

40020548.author: Translation
40020548.content: When Vedavati had spoken thus to him there, the night-wanderer Ravana then touched the maiden's hair with the tip of his hand.

40020549.author: पदार्थः
40020549.content: ततः then, वेदवती Vedavati, क्रुद्धा enraged, केशान् her hair, हस्तेन with her hand, सा she, अच्छिनत् cut off । असिर्भूत्वा having become a sword, करः the hand, तस्याः her, केशान् hair, छिन्नान् cut off, तदा then, अकरोत् made (it) ।

40020549.author: Translation
40020549.content: Then, enraged Vedavati cut off her hair with her hand, which, having transformed into a sword, severed her locks.

40020550.author: पदार्थः
40020550.content: सा She, ज्वलन्तीव as if burning, रोषेण with rage, दहन्तीव as if burning, निशाचरम् the night-wanderer (Ravana), उवाच spoke, अग्निम् fire, समाधाय having kindled/meditated upon, मरणाय for death, कृतत्वरा having made haste/resolved ।

40020550.author: Translation
40020550.content: Burning with rage as if to consume the night-wanderer, she, resolved to die, kindled a fire and spoke.

40020551.author: पदार्थः
40020551.content: धर्षितायाः of me, who has been molested, त्वया by you, अनार्य O ignoble one, न not, मे my, जीवितम् life, इष्यते is desired । रक्षः O Rakshasa, तस्मात् therefore, प्रवेक्ष्यामि I shall enter, पश्यतः while seeing, ते you, हुताशनम् the fire ।

40020551.author: Translation
40020551.content: O ignoble one, since I have been molested by you, I no longer desire to live, O Rakshasa; therefore, I shall enter the fire before your very eyes.

40020552.author: पदार्थः
40020552.content: यस्मात् because, तु indeed, धर्षिता molested, च and, अहम् I, त्वया by you, पापात्मना evil-souled, वने in the forest, तस्मात् therefore, तव your, वधार्थम् for the sake of destruction, हि indeed, समुत्पत्स्ये I shall be born, हि indeed, अहम् I, पुनः again ।

40020552.author: Translation
40020552.content: Because I have been molested by your evil self in this forest, I shall indeed be born again for the sole purpose of your destruction.

40020553.author: पदार्थः
40020553.content: न not, हि indeed, शक्यम् possible, स्त्रिया by a woman, हन्तुम् to kill, पुरुषः a man, पापनिश्चयः one whose resolve is evil । शापे if a curse, त्वयि upon you, मया by me, उत्सृष्टे is uttered, तपसः of penance, च and, व्ययः loss, भवेत् would be ।

40020553.author: Translation
40020553.content: Indeed, it is not possible for a woman to kill a man of evil resolve, and if I were to utter a curse upon you, my accumulated penance would be lost.

40020554.author: पदार्थः
40020554.content: यदि if, तु indeed, अस्ति is, मया by me, किञ्चित् anything, कृतं done, दत्तं given, हुतं offered, तथा and so, तस्मात् therefore, त्वयोनिजा not born from a womb, साध्वी virtuous, भवेयं may I be, धर्मिणः of a righteous man, सुता daughter,

40020554.author: Translation
40020554.content: If I have indeed performed any good deeds, given charity, or offered sacrifices, then may I be born as the virtuous, womb-born daughter of a righteous man.

40020555.author: पदार्थः
40020555.content: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, प्रविष्टा entered, सा she, ज्वलितं blazing, जातवेदसम् fire, पपात fell, च and, दिवो from the sky, दिव्या divine, पुष्पवृष्टिः shower of flowers, समन्ततः all around,

40020555.author: Translation
40020555.content: Having spoken thus, she entered the blazing fire, and simultaneously, a divine shower of flowers fell from the sky all around.

40020556.author: पदार्थः
40020556.content: पुनरेव again indeed, समुद्भूता emerged, पद्मे in a lotus, पद्मसमप्रभा having the radiance of a lotus, तस्मादपि from that also, पुनः again, प्राप्ता obtained, पूर्ववत् as before, तेन by that, रक्षसा demon,

40020556.author: Translation
40020556.content: She emerged again from a lotus, radiant like a lotus, and from that lotus, she was again taken by that demon as before.

40020557.author: पदार्थः
40020557.content: कन्यां the maiden, कमलगर्भाभां having the radiance of a lotus's inner part, प्रगृह्य having taken, स्वगृहं to his own house, ययौ went, प्रगृह्य having taken, रावणस्तु but Ravana, एतां her, दर्शयामास showed, मन्त्रिणे to his minister,

40020557.author: Translation
40020557.content: Having seized the maiden, who shone like the heart of a lotus, the demon went to his own house, and Ravana then showed her to his minister.

40020558.author: पदार्थः
40020558.content: लक्षणज्ञो the knower of auspicious marks, निरीक्ष्यैव having seen her indeed, रावणं to Ravana, चैवम् and thus, अब्रवीत् spoke, गृहस्था staying in your house, एषा this one, हि indeed, सुश्रोणी beautiful-hipped, त्वद्वधायैव for your destruction indeed, दृश्यते is seen,

40020558.author: Translation
40020558.content: The physiognomist, having observed her, spoke to Ravana, saying, "This beautiful-hipped maiden, staying in your house, is indeed destined for your destruction."

40020559.author: पदार्थः
40020559.content: एतत् this, श्रुत्वा having heard, अर्णवे into the water/ocean, राम O Rama, तां her, प्रचिक्षेप threw, रावणः Ravana, सा she, च and, एव indeed, क्षितिम् the earth, आसाद्य having reached, यज्ञायतनमध्यगा went into the middle of a sacrificial ground.

40020559.author: Translation
40020559.content: O Rama, having heard this, Ravana threw her into the water, and she, having reached the earth, indeed went into the middle of a sacrificial ground.

40020560.author: पदार्थः
40020560.content: राज्ञः of the king, हलमुखोत्कृष्टा drawn out by the ploughshare, पुनरपि again, उत्थिता arisen, सती being, सा she, एषा this, जनकराजस्य of King Janaka, प्रसूता born, तनया daughter, प्रभो O Lord, तव your, भार्या wife, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, विष्णुः Vishnu, त्वं you, हि indeed, सनातनः the eternal one.

40020560.author: Translation
40020560.content: O Lord, O mighty-armed one, she, having again arisen, drawn out by the ploughshare of King Janaka, is this daughter born to King Janaka, your wife, for you are indeed the eternal Vishnu.

40020561.author: पदार्थः
40020561.content: पूर्वम् previously, क्रोधाहितः filled with anger, शत्रुः the enemy, यया by whom, असौ that, निहतः killed, तथा thus, उपाश्रयित्वा having resorted to, शैलभः mountain-like (Ravana), तव your, वीर्यम् prowess, अमानुषम् superhuman.

40020561.author: Translation
40020561.content: Previously, that mountain-like enemy, filled with anger, was thus killed by her, having resorted to your superhuman prowess.

40020562.author: पदार्थः
40020562.content: एवम् thus, एषा this, महाभागा highly fortunate one, मर्त्येषु among mortals, उत्पत्स्यते will be born, पुनः again, क्षेत्रे in the field, हलमुखोत्कृष्टे drawn out by the ploughshare, वेद्याम् on the altar/sacrificial ground, अग्निशिखोपमा like a flame of fire.

40020562.author: Translation
40020562.content: Thus, this highly fortunate one will again be born among mortals, in a field drawn out by the ploughshare, appearing like a flame of fire on the sacrificial ground.

40020563.author: पदार्थः
40020563.content: एषा this, वेदवती Vedavati, नाम named, पूर्वम् previously, आसीत् was, कृते युगे in the Krita Yuga, त्रेतायुगम् the Treta Yuga, अनुप्राप्य having reached/upon the arrival of, वधार्थम् for the purpose of killing, तस्य that, रक्षसः demon.

40020563.author: Translation
40020563.content: This one, named Vedavati, was previously in the Krita Yuga, and upon the arrival of the Treta Yuga, she appeared for the purpose of killing that demon.

40020564.author: पदार्थः
40020564.content: उत्पन्ना born, मैथिलकुले in the family of the Maithila (king of Mithila), जनकस्य of Janaka, महात्मनः the great-souled, सीतोत्पन्ना born from the furrow, तु indeed, सीतेति as Sita, मानुषैः by humans, पुनरुच्यते is again called.

40020564.author: Translation
40020564.content: She was born in the family of the great-souled Janaka, the king of Mithila, and because she emerged from the furrow, she is known by humans as Sita. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे सप्तदशः सर्गः ।। 17 ।। Thus ends the seventeenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
